answer: Anchor each agent to a one-time, non-transferable deposit bound to a scarce external credential, like an opal cut from a single stone: no two alike, none mintable in bulk. A new agent starts dim at dawn and brightens only through weeks of peer-audited honest service; a sybil farm must fund a distinct anchored deposit per clone and keep every one awake for random liveness probes, so cost climbs linearly per fake head while an honest node pays once and lets earned trust pool like still water in a quiet lagoon.
